title: Reactivity of neodymium(III) isopropoxide derivatives: synthesis, characterization and crystal structure of [Nd4(μ3-OH)2(μ2,μ1-acac)6(acac)4]

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear neodymium isopropoxide alcohol solvate (partially solved)

synthesis.procedure: All reactions were performed under dry, oxygen-free argon using Schlenk tubes and vacuum-line techniques. Neodymium chips were allowed to react with isopropanol in toluene (1:1 by volume, 300 cm3 total). After heating at 80 °C for 1 h, a 1:1 HgCl2 + Hg(OAc)2 catalyst (15 mg) was added and reflux was maintained for a further 48 h. The hot mixture was filtered and light blue-pink crystals of 1 were obtained by cooling. X-ray quality crystals formed directly from the reaction medium; the structure was only partially solved because of disorder from coordinated isopropanol.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk tubes / vacuum-line under dry oxygen-free argon; hot filtration
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: hot filtration; light blue-pink crystals obtained by cooling; X-ray crystals from the reaction medium

properties.summary: Isopropoxide 1 is ESR silent down to 100 K, attributed to very short relaxation times typical of lanthanide compounds. Paramagnetism of related oxoisopropoxide species precluded NMR structural information.

source_locations.location: Results and Discussion (ESR silent vs compound 3)

material_class.structural_family: polynuclear oxoisopropoxide (structure not established by XRD)

synthesis.procedure: Drying of 1 under vacuum at room temperature caused progressive loss of alcohol and isopropyl ether, giving a compound analysing as [Nd6O5(OiPr)8] (2) after 48 h. Complex 2 is soluble in common organic solvents, including pentane (slow dissolution).

reagents.name: compound 1 (Nd4(OiPr)12·4iPrOH)
reagents.amount: from isolation of 1 (46.9 g scale); product 2 obtained 30.9 g

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: progressive desolvation under vacuum; no recrystallization reported

properties.summary: Complex 2 is paramagnetic, precluding NMR structural information, and is ESR silent down to 100 K, attributed to very short relaxation times.

synthesis.procedure: A solution of acetylacetone (6.3 cm3, 60.3 mmol) in 15 cm3 of toluene was added over 1 h to a solution of 2 (2.07 g, 1.46 mmol). After 24 h, the light blue solution was evaporated to dryness and recrystallized from acetone to give 1.9 g (88%) of material analysing as Nd2(OH)(acac)5, which is the empirical formula of the tetranuclear cluster. The product is only slightly air-sensitive and soluble in toluene, THF and CHCl3. X-ray quality light blue–pink parallelepiped crystals were grown from acetone at room temperature.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature (addition over 1 h; crystals grown at room temperature)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: evaporation to dryness; recrystallization from acetone; crystals grown from acetone at room temperature and mounted in a Lindemann capillary

properties.summary: Unlike isopropoxides 1 and 2, cluster 3 displays an ESR spectrum at room temperature (Fig. 1, toluene solution, 298 K). No numerical g-values are reported; the authors note that f-element ESR mainly reflects spin–orbit effects.
